evidence.why: setWindowOpenHandler allows creation of a new BrowserWindow for any non-http(s) URL without validating the target origin/scheme, effectively allowing window-open by default for non-application origins.

Arbitrary renderer/caller-supplied URL (including file:// or other schemes) is loaded into a new window with no allowlist/origin check, violating the requirement to deny non-application origins by default.
IPC handler accepts a renderer-supplied url/features and passes it straight to handleWindowOpen/loadURL with no validation of sender or URL scheme.

controls_present: contextBridge exposes a small closed set of named functions
external http/https links routed to shell.openExternal instead of loaded in-app
